3. The present application has been filed by the appellant seeking condonation of delay of 20 days in filing the accompanying appeal.
4. This Court has heard the learned counsel for the appellant.

5. For the reasons stated in the application and upon hearing the learned counsel for the appellant,
the same is allowed and the delay is condoned.
CRL.A. 772/2023 page 1 of 3

10.
The appellant vide the present application under Sections 389/482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeks suspension of sentence and grant of bail during the pendency of the present appeal.
11. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has already undergone period of almost 5 years in judicial custody, which is more than half the sentence awarded to him.
12. Issue notice.
13. Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
She seeks, and is granted, three weeks time to file the Status Report precisely CRL.A. 772/2023 page 2 of 3 This is a digitally signed order.

15.

16. Re-notify on 21.11.2023.
